name: User Unknwn
source:
User Unknwn follows the story of Sami Abel, who discovers some homebrew software for their PlayStation Portable that allows them to alter their physical appearance in real life. These changes have various effects on their personal life, including their interactions with their co-worker Gabe.

Entry for VN CUP 2023.
translation:
User Unknwn讲述了萨米·阿贝尔 (Sami Abel) 的故事，他发现了一些适用于PlayStation Portable的自制软件，可以让他们在现实生活中改变自己的外貌。这些变化对他们的个人生活产生了各种影响，包括他们与同事加布的互动。

参加2023年越南杯。
